args.decided_by: Gary 7 Oct (relayed by the conductor): 'Hide our S6 hangar as S6 leads into the void and doesn't really need a hangar. Do whatever works best such that P06 goes and heads eventually into total darkness, at which point we perhaps travel into the void sequence with the first glimmer of the swarm of bees ... the void sequence so far is actually pretty minimally developed, we don't use a level actor and simply bring that action into the main stage level.' Conductor decision 7 Oct: NO streamed level; her action comes into our main level. NOT Gary's (proposed): placement match_entry_yaw, start_option score_land (104 f lead keeps the five S6 markers on her music), end_rule her_playback, her set pieces (spots + floor + directional ON, sky atmosphere OFF), glimmer at her swarm's first pose from 1.0 s, handoff overlap 2.0 s. GARY'S OWN ANSWERS 7 Oct (conductor session questionnaire): her directional light OFF; end S6 at her last cut; 2 s glimmer overlap; S6 Ghost Light off in P06 too (separate step). Floor: her floor kept where it lands (no seam camera drop), conductor default.
